slide.name: 12e · Game: group pot
slide.question: The group pot
slide.notes: Template game slide (12e): the group pot, a public-goods game for 10 to 100 people, no materials. Copy it for a class, then present: it needs present mode and the lecturer key. How to run it: 1. Setup, on the slide: number of teams, initial points (20), multiplier (2). Tick Randomize teams to place students yourself, or leave it off and each student picks a team (sit by team first). Hide points keeps the screen to names only. All or nothing is optional: a team's pot pays out only if it reaches half of what it could. 2. Start registration. Students scan the code and join with their name; with picked teams they choose a team on the phone. Click the ✕ next to a name to remove a joke or a duplicate. Late joiners can come in at any time with the initial points. 3. Start game. Each phone shows a slider: how many points to put in the team pot. Rows turn green as people send. 4. Show results when everyone is green, or when you want to stop waiting: the round closes on the server, so a late answer does not count. Each team's pot is multiplied and split equally among ALL its members, senders or not. Each phone sees only its own numbers: the round change, its contribution, the teammate and class averages, the team pot and its money. 5. Next round, as many times as you like; points carry over. By money ranks everyone. Reveal scores shows the points on screen. Talk about it: who free-rode, why the rich teams got richer, what rule would fix it (try All or nothing in a second game). Reset scores puts everyone back to the initial points and keeps the teams. Reset game (two clicks) deletes every player and answer and goes back to setup; phones join again by themselves.

titleReg: Scan and join with your name
titleVote: put points in your team’s pot
randText: Students only enter their names and are placed in the smallest team. Off: each student picks a team.
hideText: The screen shows names only (each phone always shows its own points). Same as Reveal scores, off.
aonText: A team's pot pays out only if it reaches half of what the team could put in; below that, everyone gets their points back.

phoneText.rules: Each round, put some of your points in your team's pot. The pot is ×{mult} and split equally among everyone in your team. Points carry over.
phoneText.rulesAon: All or nothing: the pot pays out only if your team puts in at least half of what it could.
